shortDescription: Manage a Virtual Circuit in Equinix Metal

options.name: connection_id
options.description: UUID of Connection where the VC is scoped to.

options.name: customer_ip
options.description: The Customer IP address which the CSR switch will peer with. Will default to the other usable IP in the subnet.

options.name: description
options.description: Description for the Virtual Circuit resource.

options.name: md5
options.description: The password that can be set for the VRF BGP peer

options.name: metal_ip
options.description: The Metal IP address for the SVI (Switch Virtual Interface) of the VirtualCircuit. Will default to the first usable IP in the subnet.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the Virtual Circuit resource.

options.name: peer_asn
options.description: The BGP ASN of the peer. The same ASN may be the used across several VCs, but it cannot be the same as the local_asn of the VRF.

options.name: port_id
options.description: UUID of the Connection Port where the VC is scoped to.

options.name: project_id
options.description: UUID of the Project where the VC is scoped to.

options.name: speed
options.description: Speed of the Virtual Circuit resource.

options.name: subnet
options.description: A subnet from one of the IP blocks associated with the VRF that we will help create an IP reservation for. Can only be either a /30 or /31. For a /31 block, it will only have two IP addresses, which will be used for the metal_ip and customer_ip. For a /30 block, it will have four IP addresses, but the first and last IP addresses are not usable. We will default to the first usable IP address for the metal_ip.

options.name: tags
options.description: Tags for the Virtual Circuit resource.

options.name: timeout
options.description: Timeout in seconds for Virtual Circuit to get to "ready" state

options.name: vlan_id
options.description: UUID of the VLAN to associate.

options.name: vnid
options.description: VNID VLAN parameter, see the documentation for Equinix Fabric.

options.name: vrf
options.description: UUID of the VRF to associate.
